title: How to organize the study desk | Kids Bedroom
description:
One clear surface where homework actually gets started rather than avoided.

This is the Study Desk in the Kids Bedroom. About 45-75 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
Desk surface bare except a lamp, a pen cup and one tray holding live work. Laptop charger threaded through a clip on the desk edge so the plug never drops behind the desk. Books on the shelf above, none stacked on the surface. Chair empty.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Paper first, and every sheet goes to exactly one of three places: live work into the tray, keepsake into the m
Straighten: Pens and pencils standing in a cup within a hand's reach of the writing hand, not across the desk where a reac
Shine: Clear the whole desk down to bare wood, wipe it, then get the pencil sharpener dust and dried glue out of the
Safety: Count the plugs under the desk.
Standardize: The tray is the standard: if it does not fit in the tray, it is not live work, and it goes to the shelf, the m
Sustain: The desk gets cleared when the laptop lid closes at the end of homework, not the next morning.

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
The surface holds the current task, the lamp, the pen cup and one tray, and the tray only holds work that is still live.

6S Success turns Lean's six-S method into something you can actually do in a house: Sort, Straighten, Shine, Safety, Standardize, Sustain. One small zone at a time, finished in one session, and it stays finished.
